# A gratitude journal

A few minutes at the end of the day: what went well, and what you are glad happened.

> [!module|gratitude-journal] A gratitude journal

A few minutes at the end of the day: what went well, and what you are glad happened.

> [!activity|gj-day repeat daily] Today

Write as little or as much as you like. Skipping any of these is fine.

> [!text|good] What went well today?
> One thing is enough.

> [!multi|felt open] How would you describe today? Add your own.
- [ ] Calm
- [ ] Busy
- [ ] Tiring
- [ ] Good

> [!lines|glad] Glad it happened
> A few short lines, no explanation needed.

> [!module|gratitude-journal end] End of A gratitude journal
